objectives.text: Find the card with two green stars that a tall blue house that is beside a short green house is next to.
Find the card with two orange squares that a short grey house that is 2 tiles from a short red house is next to.
Find the card with one blue star that a short green house that is next to a short grey house is next to.
Find the card with two black diamonds that a short grey house that is next to a short green house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with one red square that a short green house that is 3 tiles from a short blue house is beside.
Find the card with two green squares that a short blue house that is 2 tiles from a short red house is beside.
Find the card with one black heart that a tall blue house that is 2 tiles from a short blue house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with two black hearts that a short green house that is 2 tiles from a tall blue house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with two blue diamonds that a short green house that is 3 tiles from a tree is beside.
Find the card with two orange circles that a short green house that is next to a tall blue house is beside.
Find the card with one green plus that a short red house that is next to a tall red house is next to.
Find the card with two red hearts that a short green house that is 2 tiles from a short blue house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with one black plus that a tall grey house that is beside a rock is beside.
Find the card with one blue plus that a short green house that is beside a rock is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with one red circle that a short yellow house that is 2 tiles from another short yellow house is 2 tiles from.
